# Garmin holiday gift guide


October 7, 2026


By Garmin team


As the holiday season approaches, picking out perfect gifts for your family and friends weighs heavily on the mind. If you’re looking for gift inspiration and want something that helps your loved one pursue their passions, pick out a Garmin electronic from our list of sure-to-love products.


## Gifts for the go-getter


### [Forerunner® 70/170: GPS running smartwatches](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-04307-00/)


With personalized beginner-friendly training plans and advanced training metrics, these GPS running smartwatches can help them reach their goals. They feature bright, colorful displays, 80+ built-in sports apps and optional music right on their wrist.


### [Forerunner 970: Premium GPS running and triathlon smartwatch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-02969-01/)


Purpose-built for performance-driven athletes, this GPS running smartwatch features a bright, colorful display, plus advanced training and recovery features — as well as a built-in flashlight and enhanced navigation.


### [HRM 600: Heart rate monitor](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-13383-01/)


This premium heart rate monitor provides accurate heart rate and expanded running dynamics¹ — plus stand-alone activity recording.


### [Varia™ RearVue 820: Advanced rearview radar and tail light](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-03180-00/)


It’s our most powerful and precise radar yet, with a wider field of view for more reliable alerts. This tail light offers up to 2 kilometer of visibility and has a brake light that shows when the rider is slowing or stopping.


### [Varia Vue: Cycling headlight and 4K camera](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-02911-00/)


Upgrade their ride with this headlight camera² that records 4K video (requires memory card; not included) and shows them the way with up to 600 lumens of light intensity.


### [Edge® 550 | 850: Cycling computers](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-03022-00/)


These compact GPS cycling computers feature vivid color displays, performance insights, training guidance, smart fueling alerts3 and more. Edge 550 features rugged buttons, while Edge 850 includes buttons and a touchscreen display.


### [Rally™ 110 | 210: Power meter pedals](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-02875-00/)


Let them track their performance with these single- and dual-sensing power meter pedals that provide accurate power data and can be easily swapped between our road and off-road pedal bodies.


### [TrainingPeaks Virtual: Indoor cycling app](https://www.trainingpeaks.com/virtual/)


Train together in an immersive indoor cycling platform built to deliver real results. They’ll get structured workouts, realistic racing and the freedom to ride any course, anytime. Plus, seamlessly sync with TrainingPeaks and the[Garmin Connect™ app](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/125677/) to turn every indoor ride into measurable, real-world fitness gains.


## Gifts for the mindful mover


### [Venu® 4: Premium health and fitness GPS smartwatch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-03013-01/)


They’ve got goals and want an on-wrist coach to guide them toward a healthier lifestyle. This advanced smartwatch with an AMOLED display, metal design and built-in flashlight is it.


### [CIRQA™ Smart Band: Screenless health and fitness tracker](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1989182/)


Track all day. Look later. This discreet, screenless smart band provides advanced 24/7 health monitoring4 as well as fitness features with no subscription required. It’s available with a variety of comfortable and stylish fabric bands.


### [vívoactive® 6: Health and fitness GPS smartwatch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1555457/)


Featuring a bright, colorful display and purpose-built health and fitness features, this smartwatch gives them the tools and insights they need to know their body better.


### [Lily® 2 Active: Small fashion smartwatch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1196650/)


This small, stylish smartwatch has built-in GPS and essential health, fitness and smartwatch features to help them feel good — inside and out.


### [Index™ Sleep Monitor: Smart sleep band](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1650098/)


Give them a more comprehensive view of their sleep and recovery with this lightweight smart band that tracks their sleep4 while maximizing comfort.


## Gifts for the outdoor enthusiast


### [fēnix® 9 | 9 Pro: Premium multisport GPS smartwatch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-04335-05/)


Built for serious athletes and adventurers, these premium multisport GPS smartwatches thrive on turning effort into achievement. They feature advanced training and performance features, rugged designs and optional inReach® technology5.


### [tactix® 8: Premium tactical GPS smartwatch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-03406-00/)


They’re built for the mission. They need a smartwatch that is too. Give them the ultimate tactical smartwatch with an AMOLED display or solar charging lens.


### [Instinct® 3: Rugged GPS smartwatch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1316397/)


Help them take on their next adventure with this rugged GPS smartwatch featuring a super tough design, solar charging lens or AMOLED display and a bold look all its own.


### [Descent™ Mk3 | Mk3i: Premium watch-style dive computers](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-02753-10/)


These advanced dive computers and smartwatches help them make the most of their diving experience with optional SubWave™ sonar-based communication and air integration6. Plus, get multisport training and smart features for their life out of the water.


### [Descent X30: Rugged dive computer](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-03892-00/)


This dive computer features a vibrant 2.4″ display and a housing and bezel made with recycled ocean-bound plastics. With 4 large metal buttons, long battery life and support for multiple dive profiles, it’s perfect for their next dive.


### [Approach® G82: Launch monitor and premium GPS golf handheld](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-02943-00/)


This portable launch monitor and premium GPS golf handheld features a built-in radar to track club head speed, ball speed, smash factor, swing tempo, estimated distance and putting stroke tempo. It also has 43,000+ preloaded courses with our full suite of golf features.


### [Approach S72: Premium GPS golf smartwatch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1937117/pn/010-04148-01/)


Our most advanced golf smartwatch features a lightweight titanium bezel, ComfortFit fabric band and 43,000+ preloaded courses with the data they need to help lower their score. Plus, they can look back after the round to analyze all their metrics.


### [inReach® Mini 3 Plus: SOS satellite communicator](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-03387-10/)


Stay connected with this rugged SOS satellite communicator5 featuring a color touchscreen display and built-in speaker and microphone, plus the ability to send texts, photos and voice messages7 with an active plan.


### [GPSMAP® H1i Plus: Premium GPS handheld](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-02921-00/)


Journey out with added peace of mind, thanks to built-in inReach® technology5on this rugged GPS handheld navigator, which provides phone-free text, photo and voice messaging. Plus, enjoy preloaded maps and incredible battery life.


## Gifts for the road runner


### [Garmin Dash Cam™ X Series: Premium dash cameras](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-02860-00/)


For drivers who want an eyewitness on the road, these voice-controlled dash cameras record up to 4K ultra HD video8 and include a Garmin Clarity™ polarizer lens, so they’ll see all the important video details.


### [Tread® 2: Powersport navigator](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-02972-00/)


This rugged, glove-friendly 6″ off-road navigator helps them find a path through dirt, snow, rain and more with turn-by-turn navigation9 for unpaved roads and trails.


### [Garmin Drive™ Series: GPS navigators](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1944656/)


From road trips to daily commutes, these sleek, modern GPS navigators can get them to their destination with ease via high-resolution, ultrawide displays.


### [zūmo® XT3: Motorcycle navigator](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-03862-00/)


From the road to the track, this motorcycle navigator enhances every corner, chicane and straightaway. It’s built to withstand extreme weather and handlebar vibration, and features detailed maps, route planning, group tracking and more.


## Gifts for the aquatic adventurer


### [quatix® 8 Pro: Premium marine GPS smartwatch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-03198-50/)


This high-performance nautical smartwatch features a stunning AMOLED display, titanium bezel and built-in LED flashlight — alongside helpful tools for life on and off the water, including inReach® technology10 for satellite and LTE connectivity.


### [Garmin OnBoard™ System: Engine cutoff system](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-02908-00/)


Built so they can move freely and boat confidently, the Garmin OnBoard system uses wireless tags instead of traditional tethered cords to kill the engine during an overboard emergency.


### [ECHOMAP™ Ultra 2 16″: Chartplotter](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1749161/pn/010-03386-00/)


Designed with the serious angler in mind, this 16″ chartplotter with a full HD resolution display brings the ultimate in big-picture clarity, brightness and readability to their navigation mapping and sonar returns.


### [Spy Pole™: Motorized sonar control](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-03012-00/)


Let them take full command of their sonar with this revolutionary motorized control for LiveScope™ and GT360UHD transducers. Spy Pole can initiate a 360-degree scan of the water and give them full control of their LiveScope with smart control modes.


### [LiveScope™ 2 HD: Live sonar transducer](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-03899-00/)


They’ve never seen live-scanning sonar of this clarity. This transducer offers increased resolution, integrated image stabilization and improved stitching, so they’ll clearly see fish and lures.


### [JL Audio® A60 Stereo: Marine head unit](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1536558/)


Enjoy high-quality audio on the open water with this sleek marine head unit featuring a 2.95″ high-resolution color display. It includes built-in Digital Signal Processing technology that optimizes their listening experience to reduce noise, distortion and interference.


### [JL Audio® M200: Marine speakers and subwoofers](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/2020431/)


These speakers and subwoofers are designed to enhance their experience on the water with clean and powerful sound. They’re available in a variety of sizes and feature optional RGB LED lighting to add extra atmosphere to every note.


## Gifts for the sky seeker


### [D2™ Mach 2 | 2 Pro: Premium aviator smartwatches](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-03199-50/)


Designed for life in the world of flight, these aviator smartwatches combine classic styling with bright AMOLED touchscreen displays, advanced flight mapping, voice commands, a built-in LED flashlight and optional inReach® technology11 for LTE and satellite connectivity.


### [D2™ Air X15: Premium aviator smartwatch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-03014-50/)


This aviator smartwatch helps them fly through the day with GPS Direct-to navigation, aviation weather information12, a built-in LED flashlight, voice commands and multiple health and fitness features.


## Gifts for the curious kid


### [Bounce™ 2: Kids smartwatch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-03399-00/)


Delay a smartphone purchase with this kids smartwatch that helps their child stay active while also allowing for calling, texting and location tracking13.


### [Approach® J1: Kids golf watch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-03898-00/)


This GPS golf watch is made to help junior golfers learn and improve. It features a slim, lightweight design and simplified interface that focuses on the most important information, based on how they play.


## Gifts for the hardcore hobbyist


### [Blaze™: Equine wellness system](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-02922-00/)


This easy-to-use tail wrap and sensor gives them insights into their horse’s health and fitness so they can make more informed decisions around well-being and training. They can even see real-time stats on their smartphone or Garmin smartwatch with the Blaze™ app.


### [Approach® R50: Premium golf launch monitor and simulator](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-02542-00/)


Give them a tee time anytime with this premium golf launch monitor and simulator, featuring a 10″ built-in color touchscreen and precision metrics captured by 3 high-speed cameras.


### [Xero® L60i: Laser rangefinder](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-02691-00/)


This revolutionary rangefinder lets them see their target with a full-color, high-resolution graphic display overlay and razor-sharp optics featuring 7X magnification. It includes navigation features, onboard ballistics and ranging of animals out to 1,500 yards.


### [Alpha® LTE: Dog tracker](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-02847-00/)


This LTE-enabled dog tracker attaches to a dog’s collar and allows their movements to be tracked on a compatible smartphone (active plan required).


Give a Garmin this season and[browse our complete collection of offerings](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/) .
